subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: After the snapshot isolation repair, is redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login proof required for this provider-backed reload change, or is focused gateway lifecycle coverage sufficient?
rationale: The contributor cannot produce a real WeChat session from the available environment, and accepting test-only evidence for this provider-backed behavior is a gateway-owner quality decision.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR gated until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup attaches redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added.

options.title: Waive provider proof explicitly
options.body: Accept the focused gateway lifecycle regressions and normal CI as sufficient for this narrowly scoped reload behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR gated until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup attaches redacted evidence that account A remains online after account B is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes this gateway lifecycle review to joshavant, and the unresolved choice concerns gateway proof sufficiency.
